verdict.rationale: Pylon ships general analytics dashboards with support metrics and AI-driven summarization/rollups (AI fields, AI Reports, Ask AI), which could feed insight into topic-level trends, but there is no explicit documentation of automatic conversation clustering by topic or proactive alerting on emerging issues before ticket volume spikes. missing for 10: explicit topic-clustering feature, trend/spike detection or anomaly alerting, evidence of pre-emptive issue surfacing tied to volume forecasting.
